audit.whatIsWrong: The page names Heimerdinger's E 'CH-3X' in five places and never mentions Harsh Lesson (W) — Illaoi's only actual gap-closer.
audit.why: Riot's name is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, 11s flat at every rank, 970 range, and it stuns only on a direct hit. Harsh Lesson is a 400-range leap onto a target on a flat 4s cooldown that also resets her auto and makes nearby tentacles swing; Leap of Faith is a 450-range self-cast that does not move her. A page that omits the 4s leap tells the player the nest is safer than it is.
audit.corrected: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade used throughout with its flat 11s as the commit trigger; Harsh Lesson added as the 4s leap and auto-reset whose wind-up is the step-back cue; Test of Spirit given its 900 range and 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown.

audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4 and 5 flipped as one atomic pair-set across phases[].side and win[], with ratings moved to the page's own convention (Heimerdinger rows 8/10, Skill rows 5/10) and the three whys rewritten to match.

edits.before: Illaoi has to walk all the way into your turret nest to do anything, and that long approach is exactly what your kit punishes. Place your H-28G turrets between you and her so the slowing beams chip her every step she takes toward Test of Spirit (E) range — and never stand on her E line, because once she rips your spirit you have to flee your own tentacles out of the nest, which is the only way she gets value this phase. Last-hit behind the beams, bank your CH-3X grenade, and let her shove into a wall of cannons she can't out-trade.
edits.after: Illaoi has to walk all the way into your turret nest to do anything, and that long approach is exactly what your kit punishes. edits.before: This is your takeover. With three turret charges plus the center-stun grenade, any tentacle-field commitment is a death sentence — she walks in, eats stacked beams and a CH-3X stun, and dies before the tentacles wind up. At 6 respect her real combo: she's immobile, so she has to walk up and land Test of Spirit (E) first, then Leap of Faith (R) slams and summons every tentacle on your head. The even window is that engage — break line of sight to dodge the E pull, or save CH-3X to stun her mid-commit, then let the turrets clean up the field.
edits.after: This is your takeover. With three turret charges plus the center-stun grenade, any tentacle-field commitment is a death sentence — she walks in, eats stacked beams and a CH-2 stun, and dies before the tentacles wind up. Her one gap-closer is Harsh Lesson, a 400-range leap onto a target every 4s that resets her auto: the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast. At 6 she still has to walk up and land Test of Spirit at 900 range before Leap of Faith summons tentacles on your head — break line of sight, or hold the 11s CH-2 for that commit.

notes: Chart flip is the one Medium-confidence call in this file: the mirror's audit recorded 'No chart edit needed' for point 2, but it did not state the row values, and the packet chart disagrees with three rows on this page while agreeing with this page's own prose (whys[4] 'even window', whys[5] 'out-trades her item spike') and the 60.93% win rate. I followed the packet. If mirror-fix.js reports a conflict, the Illaoi side is the one to re-check. Kit-flag misfires recorded, not asserted: illaoi R carries grounding and untargetable flags, but Riot's description of Leap of Faith is only damage plus a tentacle spawn per champion hit — the flags contradict the text, so I trusted the text. Packet suspectNames are both false positives: 'Hextech Affinity' is Heimerdinger's real passive and 'Test of Spirit' is Illaoi's real E.
